name: templates-dir-validation
body: Templates dir validation: before any deck validation, render or serve (startup and every reload), eypres validates the project's `templates/` directory, fail-fast in a fixed order: (1) `library.yaml` present and valid; (2) layout (templates-dir-layout: only library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ at top level; template names unique across slides/ and sections/); (3) each template in kind-then-name order (slides/ then sections/): `template.yaml`, `layout.html.tmpl`, `example.md` present, `template.yaml` well-formed against the schema vocabulary with no `usage:` key, layout parses as standard html/template with the documented function set (template-language), parse errors file:line-qualified; (4) the template-build-checks across the set; (5) each theme in name order has `theme.css`; (6) references resolve: every relative url(…)/src/href in theme stylesheets and layouts, and every `media "path"` argument, resolves to an existing file inside `templates/` (no escapes); (7) each example.md validates against its template and its layout executes (execute errors file:line-qualified). The first failure is reported as a templates error: path-qualified (e.g. `templates/slides/content/template.yaml:12`), with a hint and closest-match suggestion where applicable, in the terminal at startup and in the full-page error on reload — the same error-reporting format as deck errors, labelled as a templates error. AC: one test per step shows the expected first error; a valid dir proceeds to deck validation.
